text:
Maya: Heads-up 1: leadership wants a concise GA "accept-or-defer" checklist focused on SLA, observability, docs, support, billing. Need owners and clear acceptance gates by EOD Friday.
Devin: I'll take SLA and rollout policy. Quick callout: we should lock SLO targets now so monitoring can be wired. Proposal: Standard p99 <= 1s, error rate <0.5%, Availability 99.9%. Enterprise tighter (p99 <= 600ms, err <0.1%).
Sasha: Monitoring + runbooks own it. To validate we need synthetic probes from each region + dashboards for p50/p95/p99, error %, token throughput. Also want automated canary breakers tied to runbook.
Rami: Docs owner: public quickstart, migration notes from beta, API snippets (py/js), and a short "breaking/compatibility" page. Will publish internal draft by Thurs.
Karen: Support readiness: playbook, triage matrix, P0/P1 escalation, and two trained agents for first 48h. Need runbook links to finish training.
Liam: Pricing & quotas: I'll map SKUs, define token vs embedding units, and wire quota enforcement tests in staging. Need final SKU decision by Thu AM.
Maya: Proposed minimal GA gates (must be green in staging):
  - SLA targets set and documented (owner: Devin)
  - Synthetic + dashboards live (owner: Sasha)
  - Docs published (owner: Rami)
  - Support playbook + training complete (owner: Karen)
  - Billing SKUs + quota tests pass (owner: Liam)
  - Canary rollout plan and rollback steps defined (Devin/Sasha)
If anything not green by Monday 09:00 -> postpone GA one week.
Devin: Canary draft:
  - 5% traffic, 24h
  - 25% traffic, 24h
  - 100% after 48h stable
Rollback triggers: token-error-rate > 0.5% sustained >5m OR p99 > 2x baseline.
Sasha: I'll create the canary monitors and synthetic load. Note: include warming traffic to populate KV cache and prefix cache. Failure action: page on-call and auto-rollback if threshold exceeds.
Rami: Docs acceptance checklist:
  - Quickstart (3-5 min) + example app
  - Migration guide with mapping table from old endpoints
  - SDK samples for streaming, function calls, and structured output
  - Changelog + compatibility notes
Will post PR link by Thu EOD.
Karen: Support acceptance checklist:
  - Confluence playbook with triage matrix and templates
  - 2 agents trained + SW engineer standby for first 48h
  - Internal incident templates and customer-facing status page ready
Training scheduled Fri + Mon.
Liam: Billing acceptance checklist:
  - SKU catalog + per-unit definitions
  - Billing events validated in staging and sample invoices generated
  - Quota enforcement tested with pilot tenants
Question: Are embeddings billed as tokens or separate units? Decision needed.
Maya: Decision: bill embeddings as separate embedding-units for GA. Liam, proceed with that SKU mapping.
Devin: Infra ask: need reserved nodes in staging for perf runs (3 nodes) to validate sustained throughput and to avoid noisy neighbors. @InfraBot 1: can you provision?
InfraBot: notify: Reserved 3 staging nodes for perf test.
Sasha: With nodes reserved I'll run perf + synthetic suite. If perf falls short of SLOs we'll need to revisit batching/quantization settings.
Maya: Blockers?
Devin: Perf scheduling depends on infra confirmation (ack received). Also need final traffic profiles to run realistic synthetic tests.
Rami: Waiting on final API field names for a small example; please finalise by Wed EOD to avoid churn.
Karen: Need runbook links to complete training slides.
Liam: I'll share SKU list by Thu morning and run quota tests by Fri.
Maya: OK owners, please escalate early. I'll assemble a one-page tracker tonight and post here. We aim for a minimal green gate Monday 09:00. :thumbsup: 
Devin: I'll open a PR for SLA doc + canary YAML.
Sasha: Dashboard links + synthetic job IDs posted once runs start.
Rami: Draft docs PR link to follow.
Karen: Training invites out.
Liam: Billing test plan attached in follow-up.
InfraBot: notify: Perf nodes active in staging.
